preconditions.description: Length of the serial number is between 1 and 100,000.
Total number of changes and checks is between 1 and 100,000.

preconditions.expression: all(0 <= int(c) <= 9 for c in serial_number)
preconditions.description: Each character in the serial number is a digit from 0 to 9.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= l <= r <= n for l, r in changes + checks)
preconditions.description: For each change or check, 1 <= l <= r <= n.

preconditions.expression: all(0 <= c <= 9 for _, l, r, c in changes)
all(1 <= d <= r - l + 1 for _, l, r, d in checks)
preconditions.description: For each check, 1 <= d <= r - l + 1.

postconditions.expression: all(output[i] == 'YES' if any(serial_number[l-1:r][j] == serial_number[l-1:r][j+d] for j in range(r-l-d+1)) else 'NO' for i, (l, r, d) in enumerate(checks))
postconditions.description: For each check, output 'YES' if the substring from l to r has period d, otherwise 'NO'.
